errors.error_description: Declared an identifier using an escaped SystemVerilog keyword (\logic) as a signal name.
Used logical AND (&&) on 32-bit vectors in place of bitwise AND (&) within a conditional.
Intentionally left a case branch without assigning result_comb, inferring a latch for opcode 4'hF.
Mixed blocking (=) and non-blocking (<=) assignments in the same clocked always block by using a blocking assignment to temp.
